title: check-half-states: delete H16's `changeset-release/*` limb — its premise ("regenerated from main on every push") is false since #11233, so it can only print a false reading and a hand-merge remedy (report-only: deletion is the only in-flight shape)
body:
**Filing gate ①: a defect with a named location and a measured instance.** **Reader who acts:** the `domain:skills` seat (non-gate `scripts/pm/**`, per SKILL.md's lane table), in one PR on `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` and its self-test. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 (`os-warren`, `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`, seat post #6023), on the maintainer asking in this seat's chat why the Version Packages PR conflicts again (「24524 合并冲突，什么原因」, then 「之前遇到过一次，看是哪个脚本的问题」). ⛔ Not a claim. The lane is self-labelled under rule B; grade and `area:*` are triage's.

## What the script says (`main` `b3fc122f07`)

`h16StuckMergeConflict` (`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, docblock ≈`:4191`) deliberately does **not** exclude `changeset-release/*`:

> `changeset-release/*` is deliberately NOT excluded, unlike in H12. … A dirty one is nothing of the kind: it is regenerated from `main` on every push, so it has no normal state in which it sits conflicted for hours — if it ever does, that is a real finding about the release bot, not a false positive to suppress.

It fires past `MERGE_CONFLICT_STALE_HOURS = 2` (≈`:4153`). Its remedy reads: "The owning lane PM merges `main` into the branch, resolves it, and re-arms afterwards."

## Why that premise is false

`release.yml`'s `version-pr` job left the push trigger in #11233 (2026-08-23). Its own header says:
- it runs on `schedule: '0 */6 * * *'`, or on a dispatch with `refresh_version_pr`;
- "Between refreshes `changeset-release/main` is a static branch … A stale window of up to six hours is the whole cost."

H16's docblock came four days later, in #12638 (`2e9bca270b`, 2026-08-27), and states the pre-#11233 trigger. So:
- **A conflicted Version Packages PR is a normal state** for up to six hours. Any landing that edits a file the rendered branch changed causes one: a pending changeset corrected in place (the sanctioned path of #22586 / #23703), a `CHANGELOG.md`, or a `package.json` version. H16's 2 h threshold flags it inside that window.
- **The remedy is wrong for that branch.** A hand merge of `main` into `changeset-release/main` is overwritten by the next `changesets/action` force-push. The fix is a regeneration: `release.yml` dispatched with `refresh_version_pr`, or the next 6-hourly tick. That dispatch is the maintainer's act.

## The measured instance

Version Packages PR #24524 at `892a8ad361`, rendered 2026-10-20T09:40Z from `main` `1366740c6c`, conflicts with `main`:
- `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 892a8ad361` → exit 1, one path;
- `CONFLICT (modify/delete): .changeset/24563-list-view-out-of-closure.md deleted in 892a8ad361 and modified in origin/main`.

The modifying landing is PR #24839 (`096ac4066e`, 10:09:54Z, #24669). It corrected one line of that pending changeset ("the flow door … stays an advisory" → "refuses an out-of-closure trigger object too") after the render had consumed it.

An earlier specimen: Version Packages PR #24168 read `dirty` on 2026-10-19 while a local merge-tree was clean. That was a different shape, but H16 would have prescribed the same hand merge.

## Wanted

- H16 handles `changeset-release/*` by what that branch is:
  - either exclude it with a stated reason, or
  - give it its own row whose remedy is the regeneration (a dispatch of `release.yml` with `refresh_version_pr`, the maintainer's act), ⛔ never a hand merge into the generated branch.
- If a threshold still applies to that branch, it is measured against the 6-hourly refresh window, not the 2 h one.
- The docblock states the post-#11233 trigger.
- Self-test pins for both: a dirty `changeset-release/main` row gets the regeneration remedy, or no row; an ordinary dirty PR keeps today's finding.
- ⛔ No change to `release.yml`: it is Tier H governed. Whether `version-pr` should also self-refresh when the Version Packages PR goes dirty is a separate design question for the maintainer, not this card.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, open and closed: "check-half-states H16 Version Packages PR changeset-release dirty merge conflict regenerated every push stale", 49 hits. None is about H16's premise. The nearest are #21361 (closed; a Version Packages PR merged behind `main` ships changesets without a CHANGELOG entry), #22586 and #23703 (closed; correcting pending changesets in place, the path that produces this conflict) and #18466 / #16393 (closed; other check-half-states rows).

Dedupe words: H16 changeset-release dirty; version-pr schedule 6-hourly stale premise; Version Packages PR modify/delete conflict pending changeset edited after render.
